title: Gunsen
extract:
The Gunsen is a  Tenno bladed Warfan. The weapon's impressive speed complements its high status chance and good  Slash damage.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Slicing Feathers and  Votive Onslaught stance.

Acquisition
The Gunsen's blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

This weapon can be sold for  5,000.

Notes
Warfan slams hit twice.
Second hit of a heavy slam will use the stats of a normal slam.
The first and only melee weapon to have no imposed "roll" on wall attacks.
The stealth finisher physically moves the player's Warframe and the execution target forward, potentially throwing the player into bottomless pits as well as moving the target into line of sight of other enemies, alerting them when they otherwise would not have seen it.

Trivia
The Gunsen (軍扇) is a type of Japanese war fan used by the common soldiery for cooling themselves in hot weather. Unlike other types of war fans, the Gunsen were used more for their intended utility (fanning oneself) than for battle.
The Gunsen was the first Warfan type melee weapon avaliable.
Similarly,  Gunsen Prime was the first Warfan type melee weapon to be Primed.
